deal.product_description: MSI Pro MP341CQ is a 34-inch ultrawide curved monitor offering UWQHD resolution with a 1500R curvature for immersive viewing. It supports a 100Hz refresh rate with AMD FreeSync, and a 1ms response time for smooth gaming and fast-paced tasks. Built-in speakers add multimedia capability, and anti-flicker plus low blue light features help reduce eye strain during long sessions. The monitor includes multiple inputs and an ergonomic design for extended productivity or entertainment setups.

Remac M1 is a motorized smart curtain track that lets you open and close curtains via app, remote, or voice assistant. It works with Matter, Apple Home, Alexa, and Google Home for integrated smart home control, and supports both voice and app-based automation. The system uses a telescopic aluminum rail and offers ceiling or wall mounting options for flexible installation, capable of handling curtains up to 66 pounds. This makes it suitable for larger windows and heavier drapes while automating everyday tasks.
